whatIs: Manus is a general-purpose AI agent that carries out tasks for you: it creates presentations, websites, games, video, designs, images and music, and offers broad research, Slack integration and access to several models. It has a web app, mobile and desktop apps, and an API.
It's a good fit when you want to delegate a whole task and review the result, instead of guiding an AI step by step.
uses: Asking for broad research on a library or a market and receiving a report.
Generating a website or a presentation from a description.
Connecting Manus to Slack or to your code via the API to automate workflows.
caveats: It runs on credits: each task uses a variable amount, and subscription credits don't roll over to the next month.
The free plan's daily credits only work with Manus 2.0 lite and have a monthly cap.
It's a general-purpose agent: check the code and data it delivers by hand.
pricingNote: Free plan with daily credits (capped at 1,500 a month); the Pro plan starts at $20 a month with 4,000 credits.
idealFor: Delegating complete research, content and prototype tasks.
